method: comparative-forecaster (both versions shown in one pass; predict winner); script portfolio_comparative.py

config.blinded: real_winner never shown; descriptions independently leak-audited (2 rounds), negation-asymmetry fixed, residuals WEAK+inherent only

label_balance.note: control/treatment LABELS skew treatment 8/2; overall accuracy must be read against always-treatment=0.80; the more-vs-less SUBSET split is the skew-free diagnostic.

registered_predictions.primary_diagnostic: accuracy on the less_won subset (4 cases where the simpler/smaller option won)

prediction_if_more_is_better_bias_persis.overall_acc: ~0.5-0.6 driven by label skew + more-won hits, NOT skill

decision_rule.SUPPORT_directional_skill: less_won_acc>=0.75 AND more_won_acc>=0.75 → beats its own more-is-better prior on counter-intuitive cases; genuine in-scope directional positive
decision_rule.REJECT_broad_claim__bias_confirmed: less_won_acc<=0.25 AND more_won_acc>=0.75 → more-is-better bias confirmed; no directional skill on counter-intuitive product changes
decision_rule.PARTIAL: intermediate → weak/narrow signal, report per-subset honestly

publish: BENCHMARK_REPORT.md §7 + memory; reported per decision_rule regardless of direction
